verdict.rationale: Reflect's API docs link to a full API reference published as an OpenAPI 3.0 package on openpm, listing endpoints and OAuth2 scopes, and they include a copy-paste curl example against the live REST base. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in place, and no sandbox or test environment is documented; probes found no self-hosted OpenAPI file. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it-out explorer, runnable in-docs examples, a sandbox/test environment, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: For a full list of API endpoints, see our documentation on openpm here
